client_query_id.description: Names the ClickHouse query this request runs. Send the same id to `DELETE /api/projects/:project_id/query/:client_query_id/` to stop a search that is still running. Up to 128 characters.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: Search persons, either by email (full text search) or distinct_id (exact match).

search_mode.description: How `search` matches. `contains` (the default) matches the term anywhere. `id_prefix` needs distinct IDs and person UUIDs to match from the start, which is much faster on large projects; email and name still match anywhere.
